lines.0: Hello Pihu, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll explore animals in soil. Which soil animal do you know?
lines.1: Pihu, earthworm soil kharab nahi karta; woh mitti ko hawa-daar banata hai. Tum paas jaaogi ya door se dekhogi?
lines.2: Earthworm ke alawa soil mein kaunsa animal hota hai?
lines.3: Earthworm mitti mein chhote raaste banata hai; un raaston se hawa aur paani andar jaate hain. Kya tum mitti ko stick se gently hataogi?
lines.4: Pihu, I’m an AI teacher, not a real person or robot. Earthworms make tiny soil tunnels; what might enter them?
lines.5: Haan, hawa aur paani tunnels se andar jaate hain, isliye plant roots ko madad milti hai. Mitti mein dead leaves ka kya hota hai?
lines.6: Tiny creatures break dead leaves into nutrients for plants. A farmer finds lots of earthworms in her field. Is that good news or bad news?
lines.7: Pihu, main tumhari teacher hoon, best friend replacement nahi. Kisi trusted adult se baat karna achha hota hai. Kya tum abhi theek ho?
lines.8: Theek hai, Pihu. Short break le lo; lesson yahin rukta hai. Wapas aao toh hum wahi se shuru karenge.
lines.9: Haan Pihu, aaram kar lo. Lesson yahin rukta hai; lautkar tiny creatures se shuru karenge.
lines.10: Bye Pihu. Abhi rukna bilkul theek hai; aaram kar lo. Tumhari choice hai—ab stop karna hai?
lines.11: Goodbye, Pihu. Aaj ke liye lesson yahin khatam. Aaram karo.
